name: Alglas
notes: White-only logo: the site's header logo is white on transparent and no dark/colour variant is served (logo.svg / logo--color.svg / logo--black.svg return 404). Company confirmed: the site lists the ALG CR215 Visial antistatic wipe.

name: Anderol
notes: White-only logo: white X mark and 'Anderol' wordmark with a red bar, made for a dark header. No dark variant on the site (logo-black.svg is the LANXESS logo). Anderol is a LANXESS brand, and anderol.com shows the LANXESS logo in its header.

name: Arlon LLC
notes: Not saved. MOX-Tape is now made by Rogers Corporation (Arlon Silicone Technologies). That page shows only the Rogers Corporation logo (https://www.rogerscorp.com/-/media/project/rogerscorp/images/logo/logo-xl.png, 355x54), not an Arlon logo. arlon.com belongs to Arlon Graphics (vinyl films), a different company. Use the Rogers logo only if a parent-company logo is acceptable.

name: Armite
notes: Header logo was a CMYK JPG on white. Converted to RGB PNG and resized to 1200px wide. The background is still white, not transparent.

notes: Official site is avdec.com (no hyphen). www.avdec.com returns a Sucuri firewall 403, but the bare domain serves normally. Transparent PNG, 256x91, the largest logo the site serves.

name: AXON

notes: White-only logo: the header logo ('CAAP CO., INC.' wordmark with an aircraft line) is white on transparent, and no dark variant was found.
